name: Elalab
greetingText: I hope you like this little surprise. I made this for you, and I hope it brings a smile to your face.
chatboxText: It's Valentine's day. How to tell her how special she is to me?
idea1Text: I could just send a simple message...
wishText: 6 years of loving you from afar, and every day I fall deeper. Distance means nothing when you mean everything. I can't wait for the day we're finally together—and stay together, forever. I love you more than words can say. 💕
finalText1: Tell me if you like it.😘
finalText2: Or click, if you want to watch it again.
